items.title: Path of Exile 2: 0.5.5 Event League & Duelist Deep Dive
items.summary: During the GGG Live earlier today, we revealed our next 0.5.5 update for Path of Exile 2, coming September 4th PDT! We also had a closer look at the Duelist, joining the fight on December 11 when Path of Exile 2 fully releases. Find out more in this news post.

items.title: Watch GGG Live and Final ExileCon Qualifier - New Twitch Drops
items.summary: Tune in to GGG Live at 12:30 PM on August 27 to find out more about the upcoming Path of Exile 2 0.5.5 update, or watch the final ExileCon Qualifier afterward to earn the Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box through Twitch Drops! Read more in this news post.

items.title: Path of Exile 2 Full Release Registration FAQ
items.summary: Sign up at https://pathofexile2.com/register to stay up to date as we head toward Path of Exile 2’s full release and earn exclusive rewards. The more players who register, the more cosmetics everyone can unlock! Check out the FAQ in this news post.
